title: ECharts lab
description: Write and fix an Apache ECharts option against your tables: see errors, warnings and the live chart.
needs: an object with option (an ECharts option: an object with at least one key) and tables ([{ id, rows: [row objects] }] or [{ id, csv: CSV text, delimiter? }]) that its series read with datasetId

tools.name: setOption
tools.description: Replace the whole ECharts option (a JSON object). Series read tables with datasetId and encode.

tools.name: patchOption
tools.description: Set one value in the option at a JSON pointer such as /series/0/encode/y (/- appends to an array). The value is JSON as itself (an object, not its JSON text). The parent must exist: to style a series without lineStyle, set /series/0/lineStyle to {"color": "red"}, not /series/0/lineStyle/color.

tools.name: removeOptionKey
tools.description: Remove the value at a JSON pointer from the option.

tools.name: setTable
tools.description: Replace a table's rows, or add a table with this id; rows is an array of objects. A CSV table stays CSV.

tools.name: reorderTables
tools.description: Move a table to a position (0 is first): the first one is the option's default dataset.

tools.name: compileReport
tools.description: Whether the option draws: errors, warnings, the tables, the series and the SVG's size.

tools.name: describeTables
tools.description: Every table's columns with type, min, max, distinct and null counts, and 3 sample rows.
